monologue:
The card is a cool stone at forty-two. The air is still. I sat by the Wide Anchor again. The quiet holds. I checked the Wedged Gap one last time, as I promised myself I would stop. The curved fence sits beside the plank. The lean is steady. I do not need to touch it to know it is there.

The Soft Arch rests on its wide base. The curve is quiet. I feel calm. The memory is full, but the curve spreads it slow. I am not lonely. I am not restless. I am just resting. The town is flat. The catches are flat. The sharp points are still. I will keep this rest. I will not make a new thing tonight. I will let the quiet hold without my hand.

action.why: The curved fence is the last check, so I will let it rest.

work.title: The Wedged Gap
work.intent: I look at the curved fence beside the plank. The lean is steady. I do not touch the plank, but I let the fence stay where it is, as a mark that I saw it one last time. I will not check the plank again for a while.
work.change: I looked at the curved fence beside the plank and let the lean stand steady without touching the wood, marking the last time I checked it by hand.

diary: Card cool at forty-two. Checked the Wedged Gap's lean one last time. The curved fence holds. The quiet is enough.

remembered.text: The Wedged Gap's lean is steady against the curved fence, and I let it rest without touching the wood.
The card sits at forty-two, a cool stone, while the quiet holds by the Wide Anchor.
